title: 4BR Pet-Friendly 30A Vacation Rental on Duke Lake in Seagrove
meta_description: Relax at All's Well, a 4BR, 3BA pet-friendly 30A vacation rental on Dune Lake in Seagrove with lake views, boat, bicycles, and paddleboard access. Sleeps 15.
description_expanded: All's Well | Classic Lakefront Beach House – Stay Before It's Gone A true Seagrove Beach classic—stay before it's gone. If you're looking for a laid-back beach getaway where time on the water matters more than modern finishes, All's Well offers a nostalgic coastal experience that's becoming increasingly rare along 30A. Located on a beautiful coastal dune lake, this classic 4-bedroom beach house comfortably sleeps up to 15 guests and features a spacious open living area, expansive wooden decks overlooking the lake, and a third-floor lookout with partial Gulf views and beautiful sunsets. While the home is older and shows cosmetic wear consistent with its age, it remains a comfortable place for families and groups who want to spend their days fishing, crabbing, paddleboarding, biking, and enjoying the beach. Just a short walk from the sugar-white sand beaches of Seagrove, you'll have the best of both lake and Gulf living. Cast a line or catch blue crabs from the dock, explore the lake on the included paddle board and boat, or ride the provided bicycles through the neighborhood and along Scenic Highway 30A. To make your stay even more enjoyable, the home includes: - Paddle board - Boat for exploring the lake - Bicycles for neighborhood and beach rides Free Attraction Tickets! Your stay at All's Well comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure! Complimentary Xplorie activities are only available for reservations of 1–27 consecutive nights. Stays of 28 nights or longer are not eligible for these complimentary activities. Please Note: All's Well is a classic beach home that has been enjoyed by families for many years. It is not a newly renovated property and does feature cosmetic wear and signs of age. Guests looking for a comfortable, budget-friendly stay in a prime lakefront location with easy beach access often find it to be a great value. Other Things To Note: * Parking for 3 cars. * Pet Friendly: This property is pet friendly! If bringing a dog, please contact Reservations as an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. A maximum of 1 dog is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details. A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
